notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Dear players!

The names of characters, guilds, and pets belonging to inactive characters will be released. All affected characters will receive Character Rename Scrolls. If a pet has been renamed, a Pet Rename Scroll will be issued. In the case of a guild rename, the corresponding scrolls will be granted to the guild master.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Dear players!

Changes have been made to the game. Now, when creating or renaming, the following restrictions apply:

⭐Character name (Cyrillic/Latin) — no more than 12 characters.
⭐Guild name (Latin only) — no more than 12 characters.
⭐Pet name (Cyrillic or Latin) — no more than 12 characters.

We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: SERVER MERGER OF AZMARA AND TENAZAR!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790554/9bc118a51734a06558721dbf2e5796480fe5863d.png[/img]

Now the game will be more immersive, and the battles and fights will become even more exciting! Players from the Azmara and Tenazar servers will now play together in the same game world, meaning they will find new friends and opponents! Azmara - Tenazar is waiting for you!

Please familiarize yourself with the changes that have occurred due to the merger:

All character and guild names on the merged server that match will have the prefixes "s1a_" and "s3a_" added to the beginning of their names.
Characters that received the "s1a_" or "s3a_" prefix will soon be given a name change scroll. Guild masters whose guild names were changed with the "s1a_" or "s3a_" prefix will be given a guild name change scroll.
If you had characters on both servers, characters from the Azmara server will be displayed by default. To access characters from the Tenazar server, you need to delete an unnecessary character and restore the desired one using the special page.
All items that were on the auction have been returned to the mail.
Account storage has been merged. If your storage is full, you need to free up space, then after restarting the game, missing items will appear in the empty slots.
Items from the GXP backpack have been moved to the character's account storage. If there are no items in the personal storage, you need to take some items out of storage and restart the game.
All items from account storage have been moved to the inventory of the first character in the character selection menu. If your inventory is full, you need to free up space and restart the game. Items will appear in the free slots.
You may need to change channels several times to receive all items.
Do not rush to delete characters immediately after the merger—log into them and check the inventory status.
Of course, all player assets, mail, friends lists, and similar things have been preserved!

To receive items from the full account storage, you will need to:

Log into the game with the first character on the list.
Some items from the full account storage will be added to the character's main backpack.
Make sure there are free slots in the main backpack, then change the channel to receive some items from the storage.
You may need to change channels several times to receive all items.
If you encounter an error or problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Amid the hustle and bustle of the closing year and the magic of winter days, the entire GameXP team wishes you a Happy New Year! May your homes be filled with warmth, comfort, and joy, and may harmony, victories, and inspiration reign in your worlds—both real and virtual.

We are grateful to you for being with us this year, exploring new worlds, fighting shoulder to shoulder, and creating incredible stories together. We sincerely believe that the upcoming year will bring you even more exciting adventures, great achievements, and unexpected discoveries.

May the festive lights illuminate your paths like magical orbs, and kind words and gifts warm you like healing potions. May every step on your journey lead to success and joy, and may loyal allies always be by your side!

Our team is also taking a short break to return on January 9 with renewed energy and fresh ideas. However, even during the holidays, our technical support team will continue to take care of you. Response times during the break may be slightly slower than usual, but we will make sure to assist each of you.

With warmth and best wishes,
Your GameXP Team

notes.title: Event "Winter Fantasy"
notes.notes:
Great to see you, hero! We have serious problems: caravans carrying supplies are increasingly being ambushed on the roads, leaving residents without essential provisions. We urgently need to uncover their plans and stop this threat.

If you’ve already reached level 50, head to Carls in Tempteron — he knows how you can help. Stay alert; challenging trials await you ahead. You’ll need to complete a chain of five quests, and upon completing them, you’ll earn a large number of "small snowflakes," which you can exchange for prize boxes.

Additionally, defeating monsters of level 50 and above now grants every hero small snowflakes. Gate Bregal promises to craft treasure boxes for every snowflake you bring him. These boxes may contain powerful artifacts, hero enhancements, and other rare gifts unavailable anywhere else in these lands. The more snowflakes you bring, the greater your chance of obtaining something truly valuable.

Boxes can be crafted in the "Crafting" tab with Gate Bregal in Berneo.

To create a Small Winter Box, you will need 50 small snowflakes. When you open the box, you are guaranteed to receive one medium snowflake and one of the following items: 
⭐ Gacha Coin
⭐ 10x Huge Mana Potions
⭐ 10x Huge Health Potions
⭐ 1-Hour Rapid Recovery Potion [Non-Tradable]
⭐ 3x Acceleration Potions
⭐ 10x Spirit of Earth (Level 2)
⭐ 10x Spirit of Warrior (Level 2)
⭐ 10x Ancient Knowledge Stones
⭐ 50x Ancient Knowledge Stones
⭐ 100x Ancient Knowledge Stones
⭐ Lucky Flower
⭐ Blessed Transformation Scroll
⭐ Cursed Transformation Scroll
⭐ 5x Weapon Enchantment Scrolls
⭐ 5x Armor Enchantment Scrolls
⭐ 5x Wind Enchantment Scrolls
⭐ 10x Mysterious Patterns
⭐ 5x Invisibility Detection Stones
⭐ Red Skull Box
⭐ Blue Skull Box
⭐ Yellow Skull Box
⭐ Transparent Skull Box
⭐ 10x Flettoflower Shards
⭐ 50x Flettoflower Shards
⭐ 5x Medium Quick Recovery HP Potions [Non-Tradable]
⭐ 5x Medium Quick Recovery MP Potions [Non-Tradable]
⭐ 5x Medium Restoration Potions [Non-Tradable]
⭐ 10x Snappy Canned Food for Pets
⭐ 5x Magic Stones
⭐ 10x Flett Concentrate
⭐ 50x Flett Concentrate
⭐ VIP Status (3 days)
⭐ 5x Ancient Knowledge Stones
⭐ 2x Ancient Knowledge Stones

Ten medium snowflakes can be exchanged for a Medium Winter Box. When you open this box, you are guaranteed to receive one large snowflake and one of the following items: 
⭐ Box with a Unique Holiday Costume (30 days)

notes.title: Ice Winds Event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790554/b456192f3399567acda5f4e1ac7d9cd41d03c84d.jpg[/img]

Cold northern winds have come to the lands of Azmara, bringing with them the icy magic of the ancient elements. These forces enchanted monsters in every corner of the world. Because of this, they became more aggressive than they were and became a threat to the villagers. Daredevils who fought them were able to get the real ice - a powerful resource, the properties of which hide many secrets.

Ghaith Bregal was the first to notice that ice is not just a mineral, but the key to long-lost relics. He calls all the heroes to help protect the world from dangerous monsters and collect the ice to use it for the benefit of all the inhabitants.

But this task is not as easy as it seems. The ice winds have strengthened the monsters, endowing them with rage, turning each of them into a formidable foe. Gate warns: anyone who enters the battle must be prepared for a stern challenge.

By defeating monsters of level 50 and above, everyone will be able to receive a small piece of ice. For bringing a small piece of ice, the character Ghaith Bregal promises to create treasure boxes, which can hide powerful artifacts, reinforcements for heroes and other rare gifts that can't be found anywhere else in Azmara. The more ice a hero brings, the greater the chances of getting something of real value.

The boxes are created through the Crafting tab of the character Gate Bregal in Berneo.

notes.title: The Pumpkin Nightmare event.
notes.notes:
The scariest fun holiday of the year is coming! We suggest you fight monsters of level 50 and above to get valuable “Pumpkins”, which can later be exchanged for cool prizes!

During the event everyone will be able to create three types of prize boxes: Small Spooky Box (50 pumpkins), Medium Spooky Box (10 medium pumpkins), Big Spooky Box (10 large pumpkins), each box contains useful items and a resource to create a top quality box. The boxes are created through the crafting tab of the character Gaith Bregal in Berneo.

To create a Small Spooky Box, you will need 50pcs Pumpkins. By opening the box you are guaranteed to get a Medium Pumpkin (1pc) and one of the following items:
🎃Gacha Coin
🎃Huge mana potion 10pcs.
🎃Huge health potion 10 pcs.
🎃 Quick Recovery Potion (1 hour) [Non-transferable].
🎃 Potion of acceleration 3 pcs.
🎃Spirit of the Earth (level 2) 10 pcs.
🎃 War Spirit (level 2) 10 pcs.
🎃Stone of ancient knowledge 10 pcs.
🎃 Stone of ancient knowledge 50 pcs.
🎃Stone of ancient knowledge 100 pcs.
🎃 Luck Flower
🎃 Scroll of Blessed Transformation
🎃Scroll of Cursed Transformation
🎃Weapon enchantment scroll 5 pcs.
🎃Scroll for enchanting armor 5 pcs.
🎃Wind enchantment scroll 5 pcs.
🎃Mysterious Pattern 10 pcs.
🎃 Invisibility Detection Stone 5 pcs.
🎃 Box with red skull
🎃 Box with blue skull
🎃 Box with yellow skull
🎃 Box with transparent skull
🎃 Flettocolor shard 10 pcs.
🎃Shard of fletto color 50 pcs.
🎃 Medium potion of fast recovery HP [Non-transferable] 5 pcs.
🎃 Medium potion of fast recovery MP [Non-transferable] 5 pcs.
🎃Medium Recovery Potion [Non-transferable] 5 pcs.
🎃Conserves from pet snaps 10 pcs.
🎃Tuna 10 pcs.
🎃Halloween pumpkin candy 5 pcs.
🎃Halloween pumpkin soup 5 pcs.
🎃Halloween pumpkin drink 5 pcs.
🎃VIP status (3 days).
🎃Stone of ancient knowledge 5 pcs.
🎃 Stone of ancient knowledge 2 pcs.

After collecting 10 Medium Pumpkins, you will be able to create a Medium Creepy Box. By opening the box you are guaranteed to get a Large Pumpkin (1pc) and one of the following items:
🎃Box Unique Halloween Costume (30 days)
🎃Box Awesome Halloween Costume (30 days)
🎃 Wings of Night Box (7 days)
🎃 Wings of Darkness Box (3 days)
🎃 Wings of Darkness Box (7 days)
🎃Halloween Weapon Box.
🎃Big bag of high quality (30 days)
🎃Vrocian extract 15 pcs.
🎃Fleet Weapon Defense 2 pcs.
🎃Protecting Fletto Armor 3 pcs.
🎃Protect armor [Non-transferable] 5 pcs.
🎃 Weapon Protection [Non-transferable] 5 pcs.
🎃Platinum Fletta Booster (3 hours) [Non-transferable] 3 pcs.
🎃Platinum Concentration Potion (1 day) [Non-transferable] 5 pcs.
🎃Platinum experience potion (1 hour) [Non-transferable] 5 pcs.
🎃 Platinum Guardian Angel [Non-transferable] 8 pcs.
🎃 MV Potion 5 pcs.
🎃Perfect Potion of Strength [Non-transferable]
🎃VIP status (7 days).
🎃Potion of Experience (24 hours) [Non-transferable] 3 pcs.
🎃Protective capsule [Non-transferable] 3 pcs.
🎃Platinum fletta booster (1 hour) [Non-transferable] 6 pcs.
🎃Crystal of Darkness 5 pcs.
🎃 Sacred Amethyst
🎃 Sacred Ruby
🎃Sacred Sapphire.
🎃Sacred Diamond 
🎃Sacred Topaz 
🎃Platinum Concentration Potion (168 hours) [Non-transferable]
🎃 A box with a rune of rain
🎃 Box with rune of earth
🎃 A box with the rune of fire.
🎃 A box with the rune of air.
🎃 Water Rune Box 

If you don't want to farm, you can purchase a Medium Pumpkin from the GXP store.

From 10 Big Pumpkins, you can create a Big Creepy Box. Upon opening it, you are guaranteed to get a Creepy Shard and one of the following items:
🎃Experience Ring (30 days)
🎃 Necklace of Life (30 days)
🎃 Powerful Wings
🎃Elite leather bag ( forever)
🎃 Wings of Darkness box (forever)
🎃 Wings of Darkness Box (30 days)
🎃 Wings of Night box (forever)
🎃 Wings of Night box (30 days)
🎃 Unique Halloween Costume Box (Forever)
🎃 Unique Halloween Costume Box (30 days)
🎃Box Awesome Halloween Costume (Forever)
🎃[Rare] Box of Halloween weapons.
🎃Halloween Weapon Box.
🎃Great experience potion (3 hours) 10 pcs.
🎃Protect Armor [Non-transferable] 15 pcs.
🎃Weapon Protection [Non-transferable] 15 pcs.
🎃Happy Earrings (30 days)
🎃VIP status (30 days)

A creepy shard can be exchanged for the following rewards:

🎃For 2 creepy shards, you can get the Wings of Darkness Avatar (eternal).
🎃 For 12 creepy shards, you can get a Unique Halloween Costume (eternal)

Wing boxes are transferable. If you have printed out a box and taken wings out of it, you can no longer transfer the wings. Wings for “Eerie Shards” are given without a box and cannot be transferred.

Wings of Night characteristics:
+4% HP and +4% ATK power.

Wings of Darkness:
+4% HP and +4% ATK.

Appearance of the Awesome Halloween Costume and Unique Halloween Costume with Wings of Darkness :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/30c65174a5ba42fec2225a6f952f8684b620ba68.jpg[/img]

Unused pumpkins, medium pumpkins, large pumpkins, spooky shard, small spooky boxes, medium spooky boxes, large spooky boxes will be removed at the end of the event.

The event will run until November 6.

We wish you an enjoyable game!

notes.title: "Dwarfs" event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/fc23f3b3dcd9611cdc04c86c941534301b893ebf.png[/img]

Welcome, traveler. The village is threatened by the pesky Dwarfs, we need to find out where they came from. Scout their camp, but be careful, they tend to guard their territories pretty tightly. Our hopes are with you. If you need help, remember that you are always welcome in our village.

If you have already conquered level 70, hurry up and find Lucas from Lupert Village to learn the details of the Dwarf invasion. In total, you'll have a string of 7 quests to complete, which will earn you a huge armful of flowers to exchange for a prize box.

Also don't forget to visit your old friend, Ghaith Bregal, in Berneo, he also has a couple of tasks for you. After all, now for defeating monsters above level 70 there is a chance to get a "Flower", which can be exchanged for a box of gifts. notes.title: Event - Honey Battle!
notes.notes:
Greetings, heroes!
 
A huge number of wild bees have appeared on the expanses of Azmara, so we need your help!

Quickly find Ghaith in the Berneo location and find out from him what the reason for this invasion is! After that, take the honey pots from Anne and go to the sweet gathering!
 
For killing mobs above level 40 you will receive "Honey".
 
Also "Honey" can restore 30% of your health once every 10 minutes. So if you want something sweet, you can eat a piece of honey!
 
Collect the required number of items and take them to Ghaith. He will exchange them for special boxes, from which there is a chance to get a costume with a unique characteristic that multiplies the experience you get!
 
To obtain the "Box of the Honey Pot" you will need 10 honey and 1 pot. One of the items listed below may fall out of the box:
 
🐝Great Potion of Experience (3 hours)
🐝Happy Earrings (1 day)
🐝Gacha Coins - 6 pcs.
🐝Big bag of high quality (non-transferable)(7 days)

🐝Armor protection - 3 pcs.
🐝Armor protection capsule - 3 pcs.

To obtain a "Sealed Box of Honey Binge" or you will need 1 honey. Additionally, you need the Key to the Happy Cube to open the box. One of the following items may fall out of the box:

notes.title: SUMMER HARVEST AT KAROS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790554/ac7ff9e8e67afeb626bff57e762bf9698833a945.png[/img]

The sweetest event is back! Even if you don't like sweets, it can still delight you with cool prizes!

The character Gate Bregal is already waiting for his old friends in Berneo to give you all the details of the event.

After you check in with your old friend and get the details, you'll have to go fight monsters all over the world of Azmara. For defeating monsters of level 50 and above, you will be able to get an event item: “Cocoa”, which you need to take to the character Gate Bregal, in Berneo.
 
You will be able to exchange “Cocoa” for “Box of Chocolate” and “Sealed Box of Chocolate”.
 
You will need 250 Cocoa to craft a Chocolate Box, which can drop one of the items listed above:

🍫Happy Day (2 hours) (Non-transferable)
🍫 Potion of Concentration (1 hour) 2 pcs.
🍫 Weapon Defense (Non-transferable)
🍫 Armor Protection (Non-transferable)
🍫 Key to the lucky cube	
🍫 Balance Wings Box (30 days)	
🍫 Box of Balance Wings (eternal)	
🍫Happy earrings (1 day)	
🍫 Activity Potion (Non-transferable) 2 pcs.
🍫Hot chocolate	
🍫Christmas candy	
🍫Christmas cookies	
🍫Protective capsule (Non-transferable)
🍫 Super Accelerator (Non-transferable) 5 pcs.
🍫Tombstone plaque (Non-transferable) 5 pcs.
🍫 Platinum Guardian Angel (Non-transferable) 2 pcs.
🍫 Squad summon (Non-transferable) 5 pcs.

And 200 Cocoa will be required to craft the Sealed Chocolate Box, from which one of the items listed above can drop:
 
🍫 Scissors of Moreal (30 days)
🍫 Champion Emblem
🍫 A phoenix reborn.
🍫 Small HP/MP increase potion (24 hours) 2 pcs.
🍫Platinum Concentration Potion (1 hour) 2 pcs.
🍫Big bag of high quality (eternal)	
🍫Balance Wings Box (30 days)	
🍫 Balance Wings Box (14 days)	
🍫 Balance Wings Box (7 days)	
🍫 Box of Balance Wings (eternal)	
🍫 Experience Ring (1 day)	
🍫 Weapon protection 2 pieces
🍫 Armor protection 2 pieces
🍫Happy Stone 2 pieces
🍫Protective capsule 2 pcs
🍫Medium health recovery potion	
🍫 Medium mana recovery potion 2 pcs
🍫 Lucky Platinum pickaxe (12 hours) 2 pcs
🍫 Activity Potion (20 minutes) 5 pcs
🍫 Vrokian Extract 5 pcs
🍫Elite leather bag (1 day) 2 pcs
🍫 Medium HP Quick Recovery Potion 40 pcs
🍫Medium fast recovery potion MP 80pcs

To open the Sealed Chocolate Box, you will need the Key to the Happy Cube.
 
Balance Wings boxes are transferable. If you have sealed the box and taken the wings out of it, the wings are no longer transferable.

notes.title: Event "Stars of Victory"
notes.notes:
Dear friends!

The event "Stars of Victory" has begun on the expanses of Azmara!

In Berneo, the character Geith Bregal has already prepared a new quest for adventurers! Find him and learn the details of the upcoming quest.

Now from any monster above level 50, there's a chance to get the Victory Stars needed to craft the Victory Box and the Big Victory Box.

To craft the "Victory Box", you need to bring Geith 50 pieces of "Victory Stars". From this box, you will be able to get one of the following items:
✨Victory Tiger
✨ Stone of Ancient Knowledge
✨ Potion of Concentration (1 hour)
✨ Weapon Enchantment Scroll
✨ Key to the lucky cube
✨ Necklace of Life (1 day)
✨ Experience Potion (1 day)
✨ Platinum Potion of Concentration (1 hour)
✨ Potion of Acceleration
✨ Medium Potion of Recovery
✨ Huge Mana Potion
✨ Armor enchantment scroll
✨ Hot chocolate

You will need 300 pieces of Victory Stars to make the Big Victory Box. From this box, you will be able to obtain one of the following items:
✨Victory Tiger
✨ Stone of Ancient Knowledge
✨ Potion of Concentration (1 hour)
✨ Weapon Enchantment Scroll
✨ Wings of Purple Light
✨ Necklace of Life (1 day)
✨ Potion of Experience (1 day)
✨ Platinum Potion of Concentration (1 hour)
✨ Potion of Acceleration
✨ Medium Potion of Recovery
✨ Huge Mana Potion
✨ Armor enchantment scroll
✨ Wings of Purple Light (30 days)
✨ Ginger tea

❗ Wings of Purple Light boxes are transferable. If you have printed a box and taken wings out of it, the wings can no longer be transferred.

❗❗ Unused Victory Stars will be removed at the end of the event.

❗❗❗❗The event will last until May 17.

We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: The event "First Flowers"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/eccee6bb1092cf623f0eb285d5a5efd85e766133.png[/img]

Spring has brought the first flowers to the world of Azmara, and they sprinkled all the fields and hills. But it turned out that flowers are a favorite snack of the monsters inhabiting the world, and the beautiful flower fields quickly disappeared. So, heroes of Azmara, we need your help! The character Gate Bregal is already waiting for adventurers in Berneo to tell them the details!
 
Now from any monster above level 50, there is a chance to get the Tulips needed to make the "Spring Flowers Box".
Collect 20 Tulips and Gate Bregal will help you craft the coveted box.
 
One of the listed items may fall out of the box:
⭐ Green Sakura Weapon Coupon
⭐ Ancient Knowledge Stone 50 pcs.
⭐ Potion of Concentration (1 hour)
⭐ Armor Protection
⭐ Blue Sakura Weapon Coupon
⭐ Key to the lucky cube.
⭐ Necklace of Life (1 day)
⭐ Experience Ring (1 day)
⭐ Happy earrings (1 day)
⭐ Acceleration Potion 5 pieces.
⭐ Huge Health Potion 40 pcs.
⭐ Huge Mana Potion 40 pcs.
⭐ Weapon Defense
⭐ Green Light Wings Box (14 days)
⭐ Green Light Wings Box (3 days)
⭐ Imbic Tea 10 pieces.

"Spring Event Box" can be purchased from the GXP store.

From it, you have a chance to get one of the following items:
⭐ Green Light Wings Box (eternal)
⭐ Box of Green Light Wings (30 days)
⭐ Box of Wings of the Golden Light (14 days)
⭐ Great Potion of Experience (3 hours)
⭐ Box of Wings of Green Light (7 days)
⭐ Ring of Experience (1 day)
⭐ Happy earrings (1 day)
⭐ A large potion of health restoration
⭐ Necklace of Life (1 day)
⭐ Platinum Concentration Potion (1 hour) 2 pieces.
⭐ Weapon Protection 2 pieces.
⭐ Protect armor 2 pieces.
⭐ Happy Cube Key 2 pieces.
⭐ Large Mana Restoration Potion 2 pcs.
⭐ Excellent Potion of Strength (1 hour) 3 pieces.
⭐ Super Accelerator [Non-Transfer] 3 pieces.
⭐ Gacha Coin 5 pcs.
⭐ Vrokian Extract 5 pieces.

Green Light Wings boxes are passed around. If you printed the box and took the wings out of it, the wings cannot be transferred.
 
The appearance of Green Light wings:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/cb6e313f2c07bd2d72d4299b634f753bee37eb51.jpg[/img]

Unused Tulips will be removed at the end of the event.
The event will last until April 10.
 
We wish you an enjoyable game!

notes.title: Valentine's Day Event!
notes.notes:
Valentine's Day Event!

Dear players!

Valentine's Day is perhaps the most romantic holiday in the world. On February 14, billions of people will confess their love. They give their halves cute gifts, arrange a festive dinner and fill the house with bright feelings. In honor of this holiday, an event for St. Valentine's Day or For all lovers has started!

Now from monsters from level 50, players from level 50 will be able to knock out an event item:
"Valentine", which must be taken to NPC Gate Bregal, in Berneo.

During the event, you will have to go through a chain of 15 quests.

As a reward for each quest, you can get some of the following items in different amounts:

💖 Hot chocolate
💖 Marmalade heart
💖 Chocolate heart
💖 Stone of ancient knowledge
💖 Excellent stone of the wise.
💖 Vrockian extract
💖 Azmara gold coin
💖 Carats

The higher the quest, the tastier the reward!

As a reward for the last quest number 15, you will become the owner of a unique level 90 exorcist costume for 15 days!

The event will last until 02/21/2024.

Collect all the valentines to get into the holiday spirit!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
🎄The GameXP team wishes you a Happy New Year 2024!

The past year has left many great memories and valuable life and gaming experiences. We are happy that you spent this year with us and look forward to sharing the next year with you. We hope it will give us all even more success and achievements.

We sincerely wish that you always have loyal friends, close and loving people around you and, of course, good mood!

Let your game characters be the strongest in the universe, and together with them you will make new discoveries, meet interesting people, fight and win. We wish you always have fun, comfortable and good in our games!

❤Thank you for your activity, for your enthusiasm for the games and just for being who you are!

🎁 The gifts for the New Year are already carefully packed and stacked in the Gifts section of the game store.

The fun is just beginning, be sure to stay tuned!

Happy New Year, friends! ✨

notes.title: Important information about the Winter Event!
notes.notes:
Dear players, many of you are wondering how exactly the results of the GXP draw in the Winter Event will be summarized.

Our team is always watching your wishes and feedback. That's why we decided that your hard work and accumulated during the event "Blocks Ice" should not be lost for nothing.

After the event is over and the GXP draw is summarized, you will be able to exchange your accumulated "Blocks Ice" with the character Geith Bregal for boxes. [b]The exchange will be available until the technical works on January 17.[/b]

The total number of "Blocks Ice" on all characters in your account will be taken into account when summarizing the results.
Please note, "Blocks Ice" used up before tallying will not be counted. Clumps must be kept in your bag.

[b]Reminder that the Winter Event will last until January 10.[/b]

notes.title: WINTER EVENT!
notes.notes:
The main winter holidays are already in Karos Classic! And what are holidays without entertainment and events? That's why it's time to diversify your gray winter everyday life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790554/acdc6ff441084072e6cab454bd42bd08d09b5fa0.png[/img]

In order to participate in the event, you need to fight monsters [b]above level 50[/b] and take away their [b]Ice Blobs[/b].
 
[b]25 "Ice blocks"[/b] can be exchanged for a box from NPC Geith Bregal, in Berneo.

One of the listed items may fall from the [b]box[/b]:
🎄Azmaran gold coin 5 pcs.
🎄Stone of ancient knowledge 10 pcs.
🎄Potion of Concentration (1 hour)
🎄Protect Armor
🎄Key of the Lucky Cube Untransferable
🎄Necklace of Life (1 day)
🎄Experience Ring (1 day)
🎄Happy Earrings (1 day)
🎄Acceleration Potion 5 pieces.
🎄Huge health potion 10 pcs.
🎄Huge Mana Potion 10 pcs.
🎄Weapon Defense
🎄Golden Rabbit for 5th Anniversary
🎄New Winter Wings Box (3 days)
🎄Imbic tea 5 pieces.

You can purchase the Winter Event box from the GXP store.
From it, there is a chance to get one of the following items:
🎄Box of New Winter wings (eternal)
🎄Golden Rabbit for 5th Anniversary
🎄New Winter Wings Box (30 days)
🎄Great Potion of Experience (3 hours)
🎄New Winter Wings Box (7 days)
🎄Experience Ring (1 day)
🎄Happy Earrings (1 day)
🎄Large Health Restoration Potion
🎄Necklace of Life (1 day)
🎄Platinum Concentration Potion (1 hour)
🎄Weapon Protection
🎄Armor Protection
🎄Happy Cube Key.
🎄Large Mana Recovery Potion
🎄Super Accelerator Untransferable
🎄Excellent potion of strength
🎄Gacha Coin Non-transferable

New Winter's Wings boxes are transferable. If you have printed the box and taken the wings out of it, the wings are no longer transferable.
 
Appearance of the New Winter wings:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/df5b6fce88dde5fbc42c1ee2d5e356b230b69d16.jpg[/img]

Additionally, at the end of the event, we will count the number of Ice Blobs the characters have and reward the most diligent collectors of ice and holiday cheer. In order to compete for GXP, you must have a minimum of 100 ice blocks. "Ice blocks." A total of 595 GXPs will be raffled off to 6 winners:
🎄The 1st place player will receive 200 GXP
🎄Players ranked 2-3 will get 100 GXP
🎄Players ranked 4-6 will receive 65 GXP
 
The event will last until 10.01.2024.
Unused Ice Blocks will be deleted at the end of the event.
 
Enjoy the game!
